books.title: There is Light
books.author: Andrew Freeman (2026)
books.description: The idea and inspiration behind there is light video games that built in my internship with Persevere Now and The Verse is I have been experiencing some grief and depression in my life the passing of some family members and S so I figured the tools and techniques I use to help get me through this. In my life I could possibly implement into a video game and so I chose the music Uh I chose the voice overs because uh wise and inspirational quotes and classical music is what helped me get through my grief and depression from my losses and so I if I could help somebody in the same manner that I found help then it would be greatSome of the hard skills I learned while building this video game was C sharp i've never done C sharp I don't think it was in the curriculum with the Persevere program and what a gaming framework looks like and what a game engine looks like And to know the difference between the two and the capabilities that each independently have from 1 another are some of the harsh skills that I learn and going from VS code to Microsoft Visual Studio Code Yes they're both visual studios you can build code in them but Quite a bit of different and to build this video game Microsoft Visual Studio was the chosen route of the Unity game engine and some of the soft skills I had to learn while building this game with the internship with the persevere now was to learn how to work as a team and stay abreast with our teammates with progress and my mentor and to give any feedback or help along the way for any of the other interns there was something new 'cause I haven't worked as a team on a project before

books.title: Find my Part
books.author: Andrew Freeman(2026)
books.description: This is a project I'm working on myself if I can get it working properly I want to publish it and sell it in the app store it is a that you can type in your car part or the part number that you are looking for and it will cross reference across every single automobile that has ever been built in the history of automobiles to see what automobile shares that exact same part so you have a plethora of different automobiles that have the exact same part that you could pull it off of and use on your car or vice versa It's still a little under construction I still have to get API licensing from a couple manufacturers but that is the future for this project
